input: I want to do a personality profile app for people. grab public data as much as possible and do a psych analysis on that person... digital clones based on public info linkedin insta fb etc. (follow-up: fictional people is the way to go)
follow_up_inputs: i think fictional people is the way to go then for the legal and tos and ethical views. that's a good catch.
task: New venture persona-conversation-simulator: fictional Big Five characters, conflict styles, seeded negotiation and group-decision simulations

errors.what: First push failed sibling-links (new tool had no inbound sibling link), gitops (mirrored tool count 1297 vs 1298, gitops/ci README workflow count) and validate (committed front-door-tools alias map and kustomization stale).
errors.fix: Backlink from meeting-action-items, sync_tree_counts.py, sync_readme_counts.py, front-door-tools.mjs --write.

errors.what: Edited a persona card inside its own change handler; replaceChildren threw while the field was blurring.
errors.fix: Repaint with setTimeout after the event; caught by a headless Chromium run before pushing.

doc_friction.issue: Says front-door-tools.mjs is a RETIRED generator whose output is no longer committed, but front-door-tools.test.mjs still asserts the committed 00-mirror-alias.conf and front-door-tools/kustomization.yaml match it, and gitops/prod/front-door-tools/ still holds ~6,200 tracked files. regen.mjs --verify therefore reports 'current' while the validate job fails; a new venture must also run front-door-tools.mjs --write. Neither PRODUCT_PLAYBOOK.md section 7 nor verify-and-merge.md names that step.
Definition of done does not mention the sibling-link orphan budget (platform/pages/siblings.mjs --check) or sync_tree_counts.py, both of which every new venture trips on its first CI run.

deviations.why: The owner's first request (psych profiles and digital clones of real people from scraped LinkedIn/Instagram/Facebook data) was declined on consent, GDPR/CCPA and platform-terms grounds, matching the scraped-personal-data row in screened-out.md; the owner chose fictional characters instead.

Session gate and promptctl route were not run before starting: this was a named venture task. Track set with route --track ventures; the first two commits lack the Prompt-Version trailer because the route step came after them.

goal: Ship a free, browser-only simulator of conversations between fictional personalities.
notes: Engine is seeded rules (persona.mjs, dynamics.mjs, sim.mjs); optional BYOK voicing keeps numbers fixed; checkFictional() refuses profile links, social-site names, handles, emails and phones. Guide page's worked example (swapping roles moves the median salary by $16,000) is recomputed in page.test.mjs. Checked in headless Chromium at 1100px and 390px.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: Estimate: design and build a seeded simulation engine, page, CLI, guide and tests for a new tool, about two working days

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
